article.headline: Wheeler-Thomas hits layup at buzzer, lifts North Dakota State over Omaha 78-76
article.description: — Damari Wheeler-Thomas took an inbound pass and ran the court for the game-winning layup at the buzzer, and North Dakota State rallied from a 12-point halftime deficit to beat Omaha...
article.linkText: Wheeler-Thomas hits layup at buzzer, lifts North Dakota State over Omaha 78-76

event.description: North Dakota State Bison @ Omaha Mavericks

keywords: North Dakota State Bison @ Omaha Mavericks
article.story: OMAHA, Neb. -- — Damari Wheeler-Thomas took an inbound pass and ran the court for the game-winning layup at the buzzer, and North Dakota State rallied from a 12-point halftime deficit to beat Omaha 78-76 on Saturday. Treyson Anderson scored 22 points and added three blocks for the Bison (14-5, 4-0 Summit League). Wheeler-Thomas finished with 14 points and six rebounds. Trevian Carson also had 14 points for the Bison. Paul Djobet led the Mavericks (8-11, 1-3) with 22 points, six rebounds and five assists. Christian Richardson added 21 points for Omaha. Tony Osburn also had 16 points. Omaha led 44-32 at the break. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
